$comment: INV-123 (#1331, #1345, #1518): manifest of intentionally-optional gate scripts. Covers BOTH coherence directions. FORWARD: check-all.mjs references a script behind an existsSync() guard but the overlay/archetype that emits it is absent — a GUARDED-missing reference. REVERSE (#1518): a script is EMITTED unconditionally but wired (referenced) only at some governance levels/overlays, so at other cells it ships present-but-unreferenced. The emission-coherence gate (scripts/check-emission-coherence.mjs) scans check-all.mjs, .claude/hooks/hooks.mjs, .githooks/*, .github/workflows/*, .claude/settings.json, the Makefile, and .claude/commands/*.md; it FAILs a GUARDED-missing reference OR an emitted-but-unreferenced scripts/check-*.mjs UNLESS that path is listed here with a non-empty rationale. An UNGUARDED-missing reference (including any Makefile-recipe or command-playbook reference, which are unguarded by construction) can NEVER be silenced by this manifest.

optional.rationale: REVERSE (#1518): emitted unconditionally as an advisory thin-runner (`npx arbiter doc-set`), but wired (runWarnCheck 'doc-set') in check-all.mjs only at L2+ (INV-135). At L1 it ships present-but-unwired, available for manual/CI invocation.

REVERSE (#1518): T4 (gold-doc-tranches-t3-t5.md §2.3) emits this freshness thin-runner (`npx arbiter doc-set --freshness`) unconditionally, but it is wired ONLY from 05-release.yml (non-starter pipelineStyle) and _monthly.yml (L3+, non-trunk-solo, non-starter) — by design, kept OUTSIDE check-all.mjs so the L2 per-commit gate never carries an expensive freshness audit (solo-developer-gate-model doctrine). Any cell resolving to 'starter' pipelineStyle (trunk-solo L1/L2, peer-review L1) ships it present-but-unwired, available for manual/CI invocation.

REVERSE (#1518): emitted unconditionally as an advisory aggregate thin-runner, but wired (runWarnCheck 'anti-fake-green') in check-all.mjs only at L2+ (INV-135). At L1 it ships present-but-unwired, available for manual/CI invocation.

REVERSE (#2358): cross-model evidence tooling is emitted at every governance level, but its advisory gate is wired only in the L2 debt-gate ring. At L1 it remains available for manual invocation without adding an L1 gate.

REVERSE (#2036, #1518): emitted unconditionally (self-contained, SKIPs gracefully when no registry exists), but wired (runCheck 'decision registry') in check-all.mjs only at L2+ (enableDebtGates, same tier as doc-set/anti-fake-green above). At L1 it ships present-but-unwired, available for manual/CI invocation.
Emitted by the github-setup generator (L2+ only); referenced by .githooks/pre-push behind a shell `[ -f ]` guard. Absent on L1 projects, where the pre-push guard skips it gracefully.

Arbiter's own nightly evidence job uses this scrubber, but ordinary governed targets do not emit it. The nightly workflow probes the generated-file manifest: never-emitted skips cleanly, while a manifest-owned scrubber later deleted from disk fails before evidence can leave the repository.
Emitted only for the iso9001 industry-compliance overlay (QMS RTM + doc-control + CAPA). Absent on projects without that overlay.
Emitted only for the gdpr industry-compliance overlay (enforceable controls -> gates). Absent on projects without that overlay.
Emitted only for frontend-spa archetype or a 'frontend' lane at L2+ (INV-102/103/104). Absent on backend/library projects.
Emitted only when the design-token overlay is enabled (frontend). Absent on projects without design tokens.
Emitted only for the i18n frontend overlay (raw-literal scan). Absent on projects without i18n.
Emitted only for the i18n frontend overlay (catalog parity). Absent on projects without i18n.
Emitted only when the frontend coverage overlay + fe-coverage-baseline.json are present. Absent otherwise.
Emitted only when the frontend bundle-budget overlay + bundle-budget.json are present. Absent otherwise.

Emitted only when the opt-in regulated/high-assurance governance overlay is selected (#1497). check-all.mjs references it through gateFilePresent(), so a project without the overlay skips it gracefully while a later deletion fails. Absent on projects without that overlay.

REVERSE (#1943, E7/M6): invoked by the wave-drain skill at harvest time (per group, with --plan/--group/--base args), NOT by check-all.mjs — check-all has no --plan context, so wiring it there would be ceremony (a gate that runs vacuous or errors on missing args every commit). The skill is the runtime wiring; emission-coherence scans check-all/hooks/workflows/commands, not .claude/skills/. Emitted unconditionally so governed targets get the same harvest GO condition.
